builtinSkill.title: Install the built-in skills?
builtinSkill.text: Clauding ships two skills: one turns a conversation into skills, the other explains the `clauding` command a session uses to register an agent and to show pages in the panel. Claude Code only loads skills from your skills folder, so they have to be written there — the only files this app puts under ~/.claude. You can say no and install them later from the Skills menu.
